resources.string: Combine the numbers to hit the target
This is a daily numbers puzzle, similar to the NY Times Digits, which unfortunately discontinued at August 8, 2023.
Use any combination of numbers to reach the target:
Welcome to the Numbers Puzzle Game
It can improve your arithmetic combination ability.
No internet connection. Playing an offline puzzle. Progress stays on this device until you reconnect.
Puzzle database is unreachable. Playing a local puzzle. Tap Retry when the connection is back.

Use any combination of numbers to reach the target number.

Add, subtract, multiply, or divide to get as close to the target number as you can.

You don't have to use all 6 numbers.

To start a new calculation, select a different number.

Calculations that produce fractions or negative numbers won't be accepted.

Earn stars when you submit an answer that is:
• The target number.
• 1 – 10 away from the target number.
• 11 – 25 away from the target number.

New puzzles released daily at midnight.
